stem: A plant was topped and shows wilted new growth for several hours while neighboring untopped plants remain normal. What is the best next action?
choices: Apply another high-stress training cut to improve symmetry.
Assess recovery and environmental/root-zone conditions before adding further stress.
Assume the cultivar cannot be trained.
rationale: High-stress interventions should be followed by recovery assessment; stacking stress before the plant resumes normal function can compound injury.
